changes.service: AWS IAM, Identity and Access Management
changes.title: AWS STS now supports cross-partition federation for AWS identities
changes.detail: AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) now lets your workloads use their AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) identity in one partition to get temporary credentials for an IAM role in a different partition, without storing long-term credentials, which can help improve your security posture. Partitions are groups of AWS Regions, such as the commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, and each partition has an independent instance of IAM, creating a hard boundary between them.
